headline: Impex Ferro Tech Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Impex Ferro Tech Limited (IFTL) has initiated the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, as disclosed to the NSE.
detail: IFTL, a company engaged in ferro alloy and related production, has entered formal insolvency proceedings following an admission of a petition by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) or an initiating creditor event. The company is required to constitute an Insolvency Resolution Professional (IRP) and a creditors' committee to oversee the process. The statutory timeline is 180 days from the admission date, extendable by up to 90 additional days. All creditors must submit claims by the specified deadline.
